label: Early copy steps (outputs 2-3) of length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at the 2nd and 3rd copy outputs (recall_idx 1 and 2, i.e. t = L+1, L+2) of the longest sequences (L = 9 holds 95% of mass, L = 8 the remaining 5%; never for L <= 7, never in the original or delimiter phase, never on the first output). recall_idx 1 (the step whose input is the first fed-back token, right after <DEL>) is stronger than recall_idx 2 (70% vs 30% of mass); the top activations are recall_idx 1 steps. Within this position window, only about 36% of steps are active, and which ones depends on token identity: inputs z, l, n, 1, 2 (and sequences starting with l/n/z) raise the rate. A hand-picked token set raises precision to ~0.56 but costs recall, so the token dependence is not captured cleanly. The position/length rule recovers ~95% of activation mass.
